ABOUT ME

I am a results-driven Principal Quality Engineer and Test Automation Leader with 14+ years of experience designing, building, and leading high-impact automation solutions across web, mobile, API, data, and performance layers. My career spans global enterprises and mission-critical systems, where I have consistently accelerated release cycles, increased automation coverage to 90%+, and reduced defect leakage by up to 75%.

Holding Nanodegrees in Cloud DevOps Engineering and AI Programming with Python, I blend deep test engineering expertise with modern DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted quality initiatives. Currently pursuing a TAFE Certificate in Cyber Security , I embed secure-by-design principles into CI/CD pipelines, shift-left strategies, and observability frameworks.

Known for transforming flaky pipelines into fast, reliable, and observable delivery systems, I bring a balance of technical leadership, hands-on engineering, and cross-functional collaboration — enabling teams to ship at product speed without compromising quality.

Lets connect to explore how I can help your team achieve quality at speed and scale.
